senses.gloss:
Stṛ (used in the instrumental plural only) denotes the ‘stars’
of heaven.^1
1) i. 68, 5; 166, 11; ii. 2, 5; 34, 2;
iv. 7, 3; vi. 49, 3. 12. In i. 87, 1, it
seems to denote a ‘star-like spot’ on
the forehead of a cow or bull, but this
is uncertain. Cf. Grassmann, Wörter-
buch, s.v.; above, 1, 233.
